architecture: Unchanged mindscape.v5.model.GraphTransition. No optimizer, fitting or weight updates.
held_out_policy: 27 composition tasks have only public specs/graphs frozen; their effects are never executed or read during this screen. No data selection based on held-out performance.

metrics.changed_entity: Post-execution entity mask: any normalized true component has abs(delta)>1e-8. Average squared error over all that entity's output coordinates, then over changed entities within task, then equally over tasks having any changed entities. Invalid/unchanged tasks contribute to whole-graph and unchanged-entity metrics, not invented zeros in changed metric. Mask never enters model or inference; future supervised use would require separate frozen loss design.
metrics.whole_graph: Per-task mean over all active entity/output-coordinate squared errors; retain macro task average and scalar-pooled average to reproduce V5 dilution. Exclude padded nodes only.
metrics.baselines: Persistence; domain-local public-action baseline (unit-source register delta, literal-only edit with no propagated AST effect, unit-mass velocity impulse with no position effect). Independently executed procedural expert is perfect by definition; report that ceiling. No claim of headroom above an expert algorithm.

qualification_gates_per_domain_and_split.coding_operator_balance: Development exactly 4 valid +2 invalid tasks for each add/sub/mul; qualification exactly 2 valid +1 invalid for each operator. Assignment formed as Cartesian cells before seeded shuffling, independent of effects.
qualification_gates_per_domain_and_split.integrity: All fresh canonical identities/physics scenes/AST specs disjoint from frozen V5 public manifest and across splits; public observation saved before effects; finite targets independently replayed; no model/state/parameter updates. Stop first completed cohort with any failed gate, no replacements.

schedule: Native MPS engineering tests first. Then development cohorts mathematics/coding/physics, then qualification cohorts same order. Exactly one attempt; stop at first completed failed cohort or execution/integrity error. No composition execution.
terminal: Engineering failure -> ENGINEERING_NO_GO, do not qualify. Qualification failure -> DATA_NO_GO and stop. All six cohorts pass -> DATA_READY and stop; request explicit authorization for any learning pilot. No retry, new seed search, tuning or training.
scope: Existing synthetic register/AST/one-step contact-free physics microdomains. Fully observed physical parameters; zeroed masked AST internal values. This screen tests learnability prerequisites and computational connectivity, not trained reasoning or semantic transfer.
